raw_r_definition: max identity-placement rank assignments / eight-rank mean

selection_rule.calibration_assignment: use layer 24 plus the depth-third winner with largest screening raw max/mean imbalance, breaking ties by lower layer ID; reserve the other two depth-third winners as completely held-out layers
selection_rule.depth_winner: within each depth third rank layers by descending screening identity-placement raw max/mean imbalance and then ascending layer ID; if layer 24 would duplicate the bridge, take the next-ranked layer in that same third
